'''Kodama-hiko no Mikoto''' (児玉彦命) is a [[Kami|kami]] worshiped in the [[Suwa Region]] of [[Nagano Prefecture]], as part of the [[Suwa Faith|Suwa Shrine]].

== Overview ==
[[File:Moriya Family Tree - 守矢氏系図.png|170px|thumbnail|{{Center|The first five generations of the [[Moriya clan]] as depicted in the genealogical text}}]]
According to the [[Kaminaga Moriya clan Genealogy]], a genealogy of the [[Moriya clan]] compiled in the early [[Meiji era|Meiji period]]:

<blockquote> [[Oogami|Ōkami]]'s child, [[Katakurabe no Mikoto]], begot Kodama-hiko no Mikoto, who succeeded the position of [[Chikatojin|Chikatō-no-Kami]] in accordance with the divine words of Oogami. He married Mitutama-hime no Kami, the daughter of Moritatsu no Kami, and they bore Yatsukushin.<ref name="suwa">{{Cite book |title=Kaminaga Moriya clan Genealogy|author=Suwa Educational Association|year=1938|page=34|url=https://dl.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1185913/24}}</ref><ref name="tikatousin">[http://yatsu-genjin.jp/suwataisya/sanpo/tikatousin.htm Chikatojin (Genealogy of Moreya Clan)]</ref>
</blockquote>

As such, Kodama-hiko no Mikoto is regarded as the fourth generation in the genealogy of the Moriya clan.<ref name="tikatousin"/><ref>『続・高部の文化財』高部歴史編纂委員会編、2006th year 、31頁</ref>

== Genealogy ==
Kodama-hiko no Mikoto is the child of [[Katakurabe no Mikoto]], though his mother is unknown. His spouse, Mitutama-hime no Kami, the daughter of Moritatsu no Kami, bore him Yatsukushin, who is regarded as the fifth generation in the Moriya clan's genealogy.<ref name="suwa"/>

== Shrines ==
Kodama-hiko no Mikoto is enshrined in the following locations:
* [[Kodama-ishi Shrine]] (Yuno-waki, [[Suwa, Nagano|Suwa City]], Nagano Prefecture)
* [[Taisan Shrine]] ([[Takamori Town|Takamorimachi]], [[Shimoina District, Nagano|Shimoina District]], Nagano Prefecture)
